question: Which of the following river valleys is NOT known for coal deposits in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satluj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Satluj River is not known for coal deposits, unlike other river valleys listed in the options.
 
• Coal deposits are primarily found in the river valleys of the Mahanadi, Godavari, and Son rivers in India.
 
• Major coalfields in the Mahanadi Valley include Talcher and Ib Valley.
 
• Godavari Valley is known for its Singareni and Kothagudem coalfields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Coal Distribution in India:**

 
 
• India has significant coal reserves, primarily located in the eastern and central parts of the country.
 
• The largest reserves are found in Jharkhand, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, West Bengal, and Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Types of Coal:**
 
 
• Anthracite: The highest grade of coal with the highest carbon content.
 
• Bituminous: Most common type, used for electricity generation and steel production.
 
• Sub-bituminous: Lower carbon content, used mainly for electricity generation.
 
• Lignite: Lowest grade, often used for electricity generation in power plants.
 
 
 
• **Coal Mining Methods:**
 
 
• Open-pit mining: Extracting coal from the surface.
 
• Underground mining: Extracting coal from deep below the earth's surface.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Impact:**
 
 
• Coal mining and usage contribute to air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions.
 
• Efforts are being made to reduce the environmental impact through cleaner coal technologies.
